name: docs.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  docs.scss — MANIFEST for view-docs scoped styles (adopted into the
//  docs view's shadow root). Split by surface into docs/ partials
//  (imported below):
//    _chrome      .docs container + GL thread backdrop + 3D scene
//    _loader      docs boot loader (rings, counter, stage message)
//    _content     content column (%MAXAREA gutter contract)
//    _treeview    collapsible folder/file nav
//    _crumbs      editable breadcrumbs
//    _grid        folder/file grid + generated glyphs
//    _viewer      translucent file viewer surface
//    _rendered    markdown/JSON/report content styling
//    _protected   copy-guard + scene hidden state
//    _media       mobile backdrop-filter drop + print guard
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../core/sass/base/variables';
@import '../../core/sass/base/mixins';
@import '../../core/sass/base/fonts';
@import '../../core/sass/base/placeholders';

$_B_DOCS: 'docs';

@import 'docs/chrome';
@import 'docs/loader';
@import 'docs/content';
@import 'docs/treeview';
@import 'docs/crumbs';
@import 'docs/grid';
@import 'docs/viewer';
@import 'docs/rendered';
@import 'docs/protected';
@import 'docs/media';
